text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Pendidikan

(Penggal Institusi Pendidikan Tahun 2026) 2025.

Pemakaian

2. Peraturan-Peraturan ini hendaklah terpakai bagi kehadiran di institusi

pendidikan kecuali di sekolah swasta, sekolah ekspatriat dan sekolah antarabangsa

bagi tahun 2026.

Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan

3. Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan bagi tahun 2026 adalah sebagaimana yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

 Kumpulan A Penggal Pertama

Semua institusi pendidikan di Kedah, 11 Januari 2026 hingga 19 Mac 2026

 Kelantan dan Terengganu 29 Mac 2026 hingga 21 Mei 2026

 Penggal Kedua

 7 Jun 2026 hingga 27 Ogos 2026

 6 September 2026 hingga 3 Disember 2026

 Kumpulan B Penggal Pertama

Semua institusi pendidikan

di Johor, Melaka, Negeri Sembilan,

Pahang, Perak, Perlis, Pulau Pinang,

Sabah, Sarawak, Selangor,

Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur,

Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan dan

Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya

12 Januari 2026 hingga 20 Mac 2026

30 Mac 2026 hingga 22 Mei 2026

 Penggal Kedua

 8 Jun 2026 hingga 28 Ogos 2026

 7 September 2026 hingga 4 Disember 2026

Dibuat 23 Oktober 2025

[KPM.PUU.S.100-1/19/3(36); PN(PU2)569/JLD.16]

FADHLINA BINTI SIDEK

Menteri Pendidikan

EDUCATION ACT 1996

EDUCATION (TERMS OF EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS YEAR 2026) REGULATIONS 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 130(2)(b) of the

Education Act 1996 [Act 550], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Education (Terms of Educational

Institutions Year 2026) Regulations 2025.

Application

2. These Regulations shall apply to attendance at educational institutions

except at private schools, expatriate schools and international schools for the year 2026.

Duration of terms of educational institutions

3. The duration of terms of educational institutions for the year 2026 shall be

as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

 Group A First Term

All educational institutions in Kedah,

Kelantan and Terengganu

11 January 2026 to 19 March 2026

29 March 2026 to 21 May 2026

Second Term

7 June 2026 to 27 August 2026

 6 September 2026 to 3 December 2026

 Group B First Term

All educational institutions in Johore,

Malacca, Negeri Sembilan, Pahang, Perak,

Perlis, Penang, Sabah, Sarawak, Selangor,

Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur,

Federal Territory of Labuan and

Federal Territory of Putrajaya

12 January 2026 to 20 March 2026

30 March 2026 to 22 May 2026

 Second Term

8 June 2026 to 28 August 2026

7 September 2026 to 4 December 2026

Made 23 October 2025

[KPM.PUU.S.100-1/19/3(36); PN(PU2)569/JLD.16]

FADHLINA BINTI SIDEK

Minister of Education
